tasks.title: Задача 4
tasks.statement:
Estimate the size of the blurring effect in arcseconds by examining the image of the star in
       Picture 2. (Note that due to changes in contrast necessary for printing, the diameter of the image
       appears to be about 3.5 times the full width at half maximum (FWHM) of the profile of the star.)

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
parts.reference:
The star is 10 pixels across, so the FWHM is 10/3.5 = 2.9 pixels.                              (4p)
 Seeing is S = 2.9 pixels × 1.5"/pixel (from Q3 and 1024 pixels) = 4.4".
